idea-plugin.name: Add to gitignore
idea-plugin.description: Add a file or directory to gitignore in IntelliJ by right clicking it in project view.
idea-plugin.change-notes: v0.4 - Migrated to IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin v2; updated to IntelliJ SDK 2025.2; replaced deprecated getBaseDir() API; added ActionUpdateThread.BGT; fixed NPE on null project v0.3 - Fixed null pointer exception when external library is highlighted - thanks Jarek Strzelecki! v0.2 - Fixed issue that caused an exception during IntelliJ 2018.3.4 startup v0.1 - Updated version number to support from IntelliJ v15
